title: Blocking Main Execution Thread for Heavy Synchronous Maintenance
pattern: Running heavy data-indexing, file-syncing, or cache-rebuilding operations synchronously on the main request-handling or network-event loop thread.
why_bad: The entire network-event loop freezes during the maintenance operation. This blocks all incoming network requests and triggers timeouts across upstream systems, turning a localized maintenance task into a cascading service outage [431].
detection: Look for computationally heavy or synchronous I/O operations (such as `.merge_run()`, database syncing, or cache rebuilds) invoked on active request-handling or event loop threads.
fix: Offload expensive or background maintenance tasks to separate thread pools or asynchronous tasks, keeping the main request-handling threads highly responsive.
source: Richard L. Sites, *Understanding Software Dynamics*, page 191 / passage [431].
